# Zeca

Zeca is a macOS meeting recorder that transcribes and summarizes meetings
entirely on the user's Mac.

- Records microphone and system audio as separate tracks (works with any meeting app)
- Live transcription (Parakeet TDT v3 on the Neural Engine), multilingual with automatic language detection
- Speaker identification by voice (diarization)
- Summaries: quick recap plus per-person next steps, and a detailed point-by-point account
- Summary providers: Claude API (user's key) or fully on-device with Apple Intelligence
- On-demand translation of transcript, summary and notes
- Dashboard with today's calendar events (macOS Calendar and Google Calendar) and weekly stats
- Privacy: audio never leaves the Mac; only the optional summary uses the cloud

Requirements: macOS 15 or later. Site: https://zeca.eduardoborges.dev
